question: Which Indian state has got the highest literacy rate as per National Survey of India 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kerala__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As per the census 2011, Kerala has the highest total literacy rate in India.
 
• Literacy rate in Kerala has seen upward trend and is 94.00 percent as per 2011 population census. 
 
• Of that, male literacy stands at 96.11 percent while female literacy is at 92.07 percent.
 
• As per details from Census 2011, Kerala has population of 3.34 Crores, an increase from figure of 3.18 Crore in 2001 census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__ 

 
• The Census 2011 is the 15th National census survey conducted by the Census Organization of India. 
 
• C. Chandramouli is the Commissioner & Registrar General of the Indian 2011 Census. 
 
• The 2011 Indian National Census has been conducted in 2 phases - house listing and population.
 
• The national census survey covered all the 28 states of the country and 7 Union territories including 640 districts, 497 cities, 5767 tehsils & over 6 lakh villages.
